images.title: Prompt 1 — He whispers, she smirks
images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: homepage hero photograph.
Create one image, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Photograph of an ancient Greek marble sculpture, Hellenistic style, museum quality. Two figures, a young adult man and a young adult woman, carved from a single block of white Carrara marble. He leans in and whispers into her ear, one hand cupped beside his mouth, his other hand resting on her shoulder. She turns her face slightly toward the viewer with a sly, knowing half-smile and lowered eyelids, as if she just heard delicious gossip. Expressive faces in the style of Hellenistic sculpture, not blank classical faces. Classical curly hair, draped robes over the shoulders. Framed tight from mid-chest up, both heads in the upper half of the frame and centered. Pure black background, one dramatic spotlight from upper left with crisp rim light on the hair and shoulders, deep shadows, high contrast, fine marble texture and subtle cracks. No pedestal, no text, no logos.
